Gary, J.H., Handwerk, G.E. and Kaiser, M.J. (2007). Petroleum Refining: Technology and Economics, 5th ed. CRC Press (Taylor & Francis Group), Boca Raton, FL. ISBN 978-0-8493-7038-0 (ISBN-10 0-8493-7038-8). 488 pp.

Targeted pass. Locators are PRINTED page numbers (PDF page = printed + 21). All costs are 2005 U.S. Gulf Coast (Sect. 18.10.4) except the 30,000 BPSD refinery total (St. Louis 2007). All fuel figures are LHV with heater efficiency taken into account (Table 4.4 note b). Main file: per-unit utility data from each process chapter Unit Cost Data table (desalter, atmospheric and vacuum distillation, delayed coker, FCC, hydrocracker at 1000/2000/3000 scf H2, hydrotreaters curves A/B/C, reformer, C5/C6 isomerization, HF and H2SO4 alkylation, polymerization, SMR hydrogen plant, refinery gas plant, amine treater, Claus) in US units as printed (lb steam/bbl, kWh/bbl, MMBtu/bbl), except where the book prints a correct metric value alongside (SMR, gas plant, amine, Claus: metric loaded). Steam export loaded as negative steam SEC (FCC -30 lb/bbl, Claus -2900 kg/t S). Capex per bpd derived from printed investments at stated capacities in the 100,000 BPCD case-study refinery (Table 19.1), the 30,000 BPSD example refinery (Table 18.1) and Table 11.11 (polymerization); whole-refinery totals loaded as refinery_deep-conversion (Table 19.1) and refinery_hydroskimming (Table 18.1) with refinery fuel and power per bbl crude. Refinery steam system (boiler capex per lb/h and fuel per lb steam). Hydrogen consumption and SMR feed gas in _flows. Not loaded: investment cost curves (figures with no printed values), yields (not energy-relevant), lube, petrochemical and ether chapters, catalyst/royalty costs and cooling water (other-values). Visbreaking and flexicoking have no utility or cost tables in this edition.

(1) Table 9.1 metric conversions wrong: steam 10 lb/bbl printed as 0.7 kg/m3 (should be about 28.5). (2) Table 5.10 coker fuel 0.14 MMBtu/bbl printed as 23.5 MJ/m3 (should be about 929). (3) Table 5.10 steam and power are per ton of coke, fuel per bbl feed; ton type not stated. (4) Table 19.1 isomerization 49 printed in the steam column although it matches the fuel (0.20 MMBtu/bbl x 5,828 BPD / 24 = 48.6 MMBtu/h); the printed steam subtotal (136.7) includes it and the fuel subtotal (2,484) excludes it. (5) Table 11.14 alkylation steam 0.011 Mlb/bbl and fuel 1.04 MMBtu/bbl disagree with Table 11.6 (200 lb steam, no fuel). (6) Table 4.3 caustic metric range 0.005-0.0014 kg inconsistent. (7) Table 19.1 footnote b lists naphtha HT twice. (8) Sect. 18.11.5.3 says $0.24/kWh in the text but uses $0.12 in the formula, and 2,212 kW vs 2,272 kW in Table 18.1. (9) Location factor 1.2 in Table 19.1 has no named location.
